summary: Twelve selected items span a coherent day: a Claude Opus 5 release, a large open-weights industry letter cluster (Jensen Huang, Altman, Zuckerberg) with distinct signatory angles, an ongoing agent-escape/Hugging Face incident with fresh Reuters detail, several LLM-assisted math results, and governance/data-point items. The set is within target range and mostly well-sourced. Two low-signal items (im_harish_hari's unverified Amodei accusation and reviewer3com's thin arXiv stat) carry source-traceability risk; the available reserves duplicate existing coverage rather than fixing these gaps, so I flag them and request targeted additional Twitter search rather than swapping in redundant reserves.
